scope: Complete intended public Git diff (including staged content) and untracked nonignored files at the exact recorded bytes. Incremental follow-up after final code review, coordinated validation and final safe archive summaries.

checks.credential_and_owner_patterns: No actual credential, concrete owner ID, private key or cloud account key found.
checks.mailbox_and_customer_content: No real mailbox address beyond existing public company contacts, raw mail capture or customer content found.
checks.private_archive_references: No private raw-mail/QA archive IDs, URLs or signed download references found. Existing technical evidence document link was explicitly approved for public source.

encoded_payloads.scope: All JSON fields named with base64 recursively decoded; known wrapper/integration fixtures are synthetic.

checks.final_logs: Final integrated test stdout/stderr and independent Work test logs contain only test names, counts, hashes and source paths.
checks.handoff_claims: Handoff separates code-scope approvals from hosted/full acceptance, marks current form delivery blocked, and does not claim production readiness.
checks.private_preservation_summaries: Gmail/native-Drive/final evidence archive summaries contain public-safe counts, hashes and limitation statements; no raw private source content.

limits: This approval applies to the exact listed bytes; additional files or modifications require another incremental check.
Pattern scanning and targeted manual review do not prove absence of every possible unknown secret.
This review approves source publication privacy only; it does not certify production readiness, owner-only hosted export, IP provenance or retention locks.
